# Unlocking premium

`GameState` holds two public static fields: `premium` (boolean) and `coins`
(int). The status line at the top of the app reads them:

```text
Status: Free | Coins: 0
```

Upgrade to Premium simulates the purchase, sets the flag and updates the
status:

![Premium after purchase](img/android_journey/premium-bought.png)

The goal is `Status: Premium` *without* purchasing.

## 1. Read the flag

Attach and read the field through the agent:

```text
[0x00000000]> fridaoj frida://attach/usb//FridaMin
{"ok":true,"result":{"action":"attach","pid":3718,"resumed":false,"state":"attached"}}

[0x00000000]> fridaej "Java.perform(function(){console.log('before premium='+Java.use('re.frida.minapp.game.GameState').premium.value)})"
{"ok":true,"result":{"value":null,"type":"undefined"}}

[0x00000000]> fridamj
... "text":"before premium=false"
```

`Java.use(...).premium.value` reads the static field: `false`. Note the
value is reported through `console.log` and drained with `fridamj`: Java
values do not travel back through the eval reply, so the hook files in this
book use the log-and-drain pattern.

## 2. Flip it

The example hook `docs/examples/hooks/unlock_premium.js` sets it directly:

```js
Java.perform(function () {
  var GameState = Java.use('re.frida.minapp.game.GameState');
  GameState.premium.value = true;
  console.log('premium is now ' + GameState.premium.value);
});
```

```text
[0x00000000]> fridalj docs/examples/hooks/unlock_premium.js
{"ok":true,"result":{"value":null,"type":"undefined"}}

[0x00000000]> fridamj
... "text":"premium is now true"
... "text":"premium status refreshed"
```

## 3. Verify in the app

The status line changes immediately to `Status: Premium | Coins: 0`. The
hook refreshes the cached status view on Android's main thread, so no
additional app action is required. Press Upgrade to Premium optionally: the
feedback line then reads `Premium already active`, confirming that the flag
was already set.

![Premium without purchasing](img/android_journey/premium-hooked.png)

> **Note:** the flag lives in the ART heap of the running app. A fresh app
> launch resets it to `false`. The hook is a runtime patch, not a file
> patch.

## Alternative: flip it in one line

The same change without a file, as a one-liner:

```text
[0x00000000]> fridaej "Java.perform(function(){Java.use('re.frida.minapp.game.GameState').premium.value = true})"
{"ok":true,"result":{"value":null,"type":"undefined"}}
```

Quote the expression carefully: spaces and quotes inside a single command
are easy to get wrong. For anything longer than a line, use `fridalj`.

::: {.callout-tip}
### Try

Set `premium` to `false` after unlocking, read it back, then unlock again.
Use both the hook file and the one-liner.
:::
